title: Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

reading.body:
An AI image generation system was used to create non-consensual sexual imagery of a real person. The person obtained source photographs from the victim's private social media accounts and used AI to generate obscene morphed images, then distributed them across multiple platforms including Discord servers and fake Instagram accounts to harass her. The system was deployed with no technical or social controls on what it could be used to create.

The failure occurred entirely in deployment and intent. Nothing in the facts indicates the AI system itself was defective, misconfigured, or operated outside design parameters. The person deliberately obtained private images, deliberately chose to abuse the generation tool, and deliberately chose distribution methods to evade detection. It would have taken human review of outputs before distribution to block this, or platform controls that prevent re-upload of generated images, or detection of the coordinated fake accounts at the point of creation.

It is not established whether the AI image generation system had safety features, what platform policies governed its use, or whether any prevention measures existed before or after discovery of the abuse.

reports.title: Delhi: Man held for circulating obscene AI-generated photos of college acquaintance
Resentment leads techie to circulate fake obscene images of woman online

summary:
A 22-year-old man named Keshav Bansal was arrested in Delhi for creating and distributing sexually explicit images generated using artificial intelligence. The suspect obtained photographs of a 22-year-old college acquaintance from her private social media accounts and used AI technology to create obscene morphed images. He then uploaded these images to anonymous Discord servers and posted them on fake Instagram accounts to harass and humiliate the victim.

The victim discovered the abuse when she received messages from anonymous Instagram accounts informing her that morphed photographs and videos were being circulated. She reported the case to Delhi's Cyber Police Station. Investigators analyzed digital footprints and traced connections between multiple fake profiles, email accounts, and Discord servers to identify Bansal. During questioning, he admitted knowing the complainant from college and claimed personal resentment motivated his actions. Police recovered his mobile phone, SIM cards, and digital evidence. The investigation is continuing.
